subject: Level expectations & interviewer slot ownership — Platform Engineer candidate slate
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Reddy <asha.recruiter@talentflow.co>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Level expectations & slot ownership for Platform Eng slate - Priyanka Sen

Hi team —

We have Priyanka Sen (resume attached) in the loop for the Platform Engineer role (IC4/IC5 range). Asha has slotted live interviews for Thurs/Friday. Before interviews start I want to align on two things quickly:

1) Level expectations: please call out the single most important signal you need to feel comfortable at IC4 vs IC5 (e.g., system design breadth, ownership portfolio, cross-team impact).

2) Slot ownership & debrief flow: who will own final debrief capture and scoring for each slot? We need one person to consolidate and ensure we hit the scorecard timelines (24h).

Attachments: Priyanka_Sen_resume_JD473.pdf (candidate resume, redacted contacts).

Notes: I want interviews to focus narrower than usual — prioritize productionizing LLM infra/serving tradeoffs and post-deploy observability rather than low-level device kernels. See the Notion link below for the provisional level rubric.

Can each of you reply with your Level signal + which slot you’ll own? If anyone wants to swap slots, flag here and I’ll re-run with Asha.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Recruiting Partner (Hiring Manager)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Level expectations & slot ownership for Platform Eng slate - Priyanka Sen

Vanessa —

Quick take: the clearest IC5 signal for me is ownership of a cross-team serving platform (not just a single pipeline) and evidence of shipping SLA-backed features that required infra tradeoffs. For IC4 I want to see solid ownership of one production service, strong debugging patterns, and familiarity with cost/latency tradeoffs.

I can take the afternoon design slot on Thursday and will own the debrief aggregation for the design + architecture notes. I’ll use the debrief template and push the consolidated doc to the hiring channel within 12 hours.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff ML Infrastructure (interviewer)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Level expectations & slot ownership for Platform Eng slate - Priyanka Sen

Thanks Vanessa — adding my bar-raiser perspective:

- Core IC5 marker: end-to-end product judgement on inference economics (not just bench numbers) + demonstrated ability to push back on roadmap when infra constraints risk product quality.
- Interview focus areas for me: scaling KV/embedding caches, fallback strategies under tail latency, and measurable quality regressions when changing batching/quantization.

Logistics: I’ll take the Friday morning reliability slot. I’ll also make a short call-out in the rubric about behavioral signals (ownership, stakeholder influence). Link to my short rubric notes: https://notion.redwood.com/scorecards/platform-engineer-level-definitions

Attachment: debrief_template_platform_engineer.docx (please use this during capture).

-Markus
Markus Klein
Principal Engineer — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
